cases.question: What are the entrance requirements for the Computer Information Technology diploma at BCIT?
cases.standalone_question: What are the entrance requirements for the Computer Information Technology diploma at BCIT?
cases.answer_excerpt:
To be eligible for the full-time Computer Information Technology (CIT) diploma, you must meet the following entrance requirements:

*   **English Language Proficiency:** Category 2 – English Studies 12 (67%) or an equivalent.
*   **Mathematics:** One of the following:
    *   Pre-Calculus 12 (67%)
    *   Foundations of Math 12 (73%)
    *   Other acceptable BC and Yukon courses.

Applicants are accepted on a first-qualified basis as long as space remains in the program. You must provide proof of meeting these requirements when you submit your application.

If you have previously completed equivalent courses at BCIT or another institution, you may be eligible for transfer credit, provided you earned a minimum grade of 60% and completed the coursework within the last five years. You can apply for this after being accepted into the program by submitting a Course Credit Exemption form.

For further details on meeting these requirements or information regarding the application process, you can visit the official BCIT website.

Sources:
https://www.bcit.ca/programs/computer-information-technology-diploma-full-time-5540dipma/
sub_queries: BCIT Computer Information Technology diploma entrance requirements

To be eligible for the full-time Biomedical Engineering Technology diploma, you must meet the following science entrance requirements:

*   **Chemistry:** You need one of the following (or equivalent) with a minimum grade of 67%:
    *   Chemistry 11
    *   Chemistry 12
    *   CHEM 0110 – Chemistry 11 Challenge Exam
    *   CHEM 0120 – Chemistry 12 Challenge Exam
    *   3.0 credits of post-secondary chemistry
*   **Physics:** You need one of the following (or equivalent) with a minimum grade of 67%:
    *   Physics 12
    *   PHYS 0312 – Technology Entry Physics 2
    *   PHYS 0120 – Physics 12 Challenge Exam
    *   3.0 credits of post-secondary physics at the 100 level or higher

Please ensure that any post-secondary credits are from a recognized institution.

cases.answer_excerpt:
Conditionally selected applicants to the full-time Biomedical Engineering Technology diploma program must complete the following requirements to receive full acceptance:

*   **Criminal Record Check:** Required as per the British Columbia Criminal Records Review Act for students engaging with children or vulnerable adults during their practicum.

cases.question: What post-secondary courses are part of the Academic Foundations requirement for BCIT's full-time Bachelor of Science in Nursing?
cases.standalone_question: What post-secondary courses are part of the Academic Foundations requirement for BCIT's full-time Bachelor of Science in Nursing?
cases.answer_excerpt:
To meet the Academic Foundations requirement for the full-time Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) program, you must complete 18.0 post-secondary credits with a minimum grade of 67% in each of the following:

*   **ENGL 1177 – Academic Writing** (or an equivalent 3.0-credit course). Note that this course may also be used to satisfy the English language proficiency requirement.
*   **BHSC 1200 – Human Anatomy and Physiology** (or an equivalent 6.0-credit course). This must have been completed within the past three years.
*   **PSYC 1101 – Introductory Psychology 1** (or an equivalent 3.0-credit course).
*   **General Education electives** (6.0 credits total): These must be at a 100-level minimum and taken in at least two different academic disciplines.

cases.question: If BCIT grants me transfer credit for a course, does my program tuition go down, and how must transcripts be submitted?
cases.standalone_question: If BCIT grants me transfer credit for a course, does my program tuition go down, and how must transcripts be submitted?
cases.answer_excerpt:
If you are granted transfer credit for a course in a full-time program, your tuition will generally not be reduced, though your course load will be lighter.

Regarding the submission of transcripts for transfer credit:

*   **Official Transcripts Required:** You must have your official transcripts sent directly to BCIT from the institution(s) you previously attended.
*   **Alternative Submission:** Alternatively, you may drop off your official transcript in a sealed, stamped envelope.
*   **Restrictions:** Scans of transcripts are not accepted.
*   **Application Process:** You must complete a Course Credit/Exemption form and submit it along with your official transcript. For full-time programs, this is done after you have been accepted into your chosen program.

Please note that if you are applying for financial aid, receiving transfer credit may affect your eligibility for certain types of assistance if you no longer carry the required minimum course load.

cases.question: BCIT 간호 프로그램 입학하려면 뭐가 필요해?
cases.standalone_question: BCIT 간호 프로그램 입학하려면 뭐가 필요해?
cases.answer_excerpt:
BCIT의 전문 간호(Specialty Nursing) 프로그램에 입학하기 위해서는 일반적으로 다음과 같은 자격 요건이 필요합니다.

*   **학력:** 간호학 디플로마(Diploma in Nursing)를 소지해야 합니다.
*   **영어 능력:** Category 1 기준을 충족해야 하며, 이는 English Studies 12에서 73% 이상의 성적을 거두거나 그에 상응하는 자격을 갖추는 것을 의미합니다.
*   **등록 자격:** BC College of Nurses and Midwives(BCCNM) 또는 캐나다 내 타 주의 동등한 기관에 현재 등록된 간호사여야 합니다. 캐나다 외 지역에서 활동 중인 경우 RN 면허 번호가 필요합니다.
*   **경력:** 급성기 치료(acute care) 환경에서 최소 6개월 이상의 경력이 필요합니다. 지원 시 경력 사항이 기재된 이력서를 제출해야 합니다.
*   **기타:** 최근 2년 이내의 급성기 치료 경력이 없는 경우, 보충 교육(refresher course) 이수가 요구될 수 있습니다.

**임상 실습 관련 필수 사항:**
임상 실습에 참여하는 모든 학생은 다음을 준비해야 합니다:
*   **CPR:** 캐나다 기관에서 발급한 유효한 CPR Level C 또는 Health Care Provider(HCP) 자격증(실습 포함).
*   **예방 접종:** 인플루엔자 백신 접종 증명서 또는 실습 중 마스크 착용 동의.
*   **등록 증명:** 각 임상 과정마다 BCCNM 회원 자격 또는 RN 면허 번호 증명.
*   **호흡기 적합성 테스트:** N95 마스크(1860, 1860s, 또는 1870 모델)에 대한 적합성 테스트(Fit Testing) 완료 및 증명서 지참.

국제 지원자의 경우, 캐나다 외부에서 프로그램을 이수하거나 캐나다 내 유효한 취업 비자를 소지하고 있어야 합니다. 단, 이 프로그램으로는 학생 비자(Study permit)를 받을 수 없습니다.

구체적인 프로그램별 세부 사항이나 본인의 경력 인정 여부에 대해서는 해당 프로그램의 학과장(program head)에게 문의하시기 바랍니다.

Sources:

https://www.bcit.ca/programs/specialty-nursing-perinatal-standard-option-bachelor-of-science-in-nursing-part-time-810gbsn/

cases.follow_up: How many business days after the start of class do I have to withdraw to get a refund?
cases.standalone_question: How many business days after the start of class do I have to withdraw from a BCIT full-time program to get a refund?

prior_turns.question: Tell me about BCIT's refund policy for full-time programs.

cases.answer_excerpt:
For most full-time programs, the latest acceptable withdrawal date to receive a tuition refund is 10 business days after the start of class.

Please note that if you are required to withdraw due to disciplinary reasons or unsatisfactory progress after this deadline, you will not be eligible for a refund. Additionally, all commitment fees are non-refundable.

Sources:
- https://www.bcit.ca/admission/tuition-fees/refunds-withdrawals/

cases.question: Tell me about the Biomedical Engineering Technology diploma.
cases.follow_up: Do I need chemistry to get in?
cases.standalone_question: Are there chemistry requirements for admission to the BCIT Biomedical Engineering Technology diploma program?

prior_turns.question: Tell me about the Biomedical Engineering Technology diploma.

cases.answer_excerpt:
Yes, you need chemistry to be admitted to the Biomedical Engineering Technology diploma program.

As part of the program's entrance requirements, you must meet one of the following chemistry criteria:

*   Chemistry 11 (67%)
*   Chemistry 12 (67%)
*   CHEM 0110 – Chemistry 11 Challenge Exam – BCIT (67%)
*   CHEM 0120 – Chemistry 12 Challenge Exam – BCIT (67%)
*   3.0 credits of post-secondary chemistry (67%) from a recognized institution

You must provide proof of meeting this requirement when you submit your online application.

Sources:
- https://www.bcit.ca/programs/biomedical-engineering-technology-diploma-full-time-5063dipma/
